title: Akiyama Mizuki — Making Chocolates With Children〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... What to do for White Day...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Something simple that doesn't really imply anything is probably my safest bet.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (To be fair, Ena might be the only person I know who believes that candy means, “I like you,” and marshmallows mean, “I don't like you.”)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but these heart-shaped chocolates are pretty cute...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, this one uses a huge bar of chocolate as its base. That's so cool! They didn't even melt it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this one's way too cute!
It looks just like a lollipop!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu went out of their way to get me chocolates, so I kinda want to give back something nice.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Chocolates of different shapes and sizes for each person would be ideal...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'd need a bunch of different ingredients and cookware to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... What else would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hm...?
What's this ad for?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Let's see... The “Chocolate Factory”?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, it's a factory with a museum.
They even have a kitchen studio where visitors can make their own chocolates.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, they're even putting on demos for White Day!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, we can use all the ingredients and cookware that are there?! And we can make them how we like?! This is it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, I've gotta check this place out♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, I should invite someone along!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena's... No, it's still noon. She's probably sound asleep. I'll have to wait until later tonight.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
An's the next person on my list.
She's probably on lunch break now, so I think I'll give her a call...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Hello?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hey, An!
Are you free right now?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I was just having lunch.
What's up?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There's this place I'm thinking about checking out♪ It's called the Chocolate Factory.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Apparently, you can make your own chocolates if you go!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sounds fun, right? Wanna come with?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Making your own chocolates does sound fun! When do you plan on going?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Um... Sometime before White Day if possible, so... This weekend!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, this weekend...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Do you have practice? Or an event?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <There's also that, but I promised to help out at our place this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's too bad. I guess business is business.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Sorry. Hey, hold on.
Why don't you invite Akito's sister?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I have a feeling that she won't want to be bothered with something like this...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Who else do you think would want to go?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<Hmm... What about Kamishiro?
You two are pretty close, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Rui? He'd probably be more interested in machinery than chocolate.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, his troupe usually has practice on weekends, so I doubt he'll be free to go on such short notice.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Then, why not Akito?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <He likes sweets, so he might be willing to go.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I see your point...
You really think he'll want to go?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Won't he just say the same thing as Ena? He probably won't want to bother with something like this.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <I mean, they're doing chocolate-making demos for White Day, right?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Despite the way he talks, he's pretty old-fashioned. I have a feeling he's still figuring out what to give back, so he might want to go. Who knows?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Also... This Chocolate Factory sells its own chocolates, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... Oh, I almost forgot. The ad said this famous chocolatier names Paul Hansen is supposed to be visiting.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It even mentioned how participating in the demo gives you an opportunity to buy his latest creations.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Really?! That means you can buy chocolates for yourself and make some for White Day! Two birds with one stone!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <There's no way Akito can say no to that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Interesting. I didn't realize Li'l Bro liked sweets that much.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks, An.
I'll try asking him if Ena says she isn't up to it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Also, sorry for taking so much time out of your lunch break.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
<No problem!
Call me again if something comes up, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I will! Bye bye♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena or Li'l Bro... It should be fun either way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hold on. I don't have to just invite one of them. Why not both? I could invite Toya along too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't wait to see how things turn out. First, I'll ask Ena to see what she thinks♪
